overview.eyebrow: At the back of the book
overview.title: All settings
overview.intro: Everything Dialogbot knows and does – in one place, in plain language. «Change» on a simple value sends it to the assistant, which shows you the change before it applies. Larger forms open as a sheet.

knowledge.sub: What it knows, and what it must not do

booking.appointmentsValue: This week's appointments and book for a customer

types.intro: E.g. "Site visit" or "In-store consultation". The duration determines how long the offered slots are.
types.name: Name

settings.title: Online booking and calendar
settings.enabled: Customers may book in the chat and on the phone
settings.needType: Create at least one booking type first.
settings.icsLabel: 1. Busy time: your calendar's secret iCal address
settings.icsHelp: Google: Settings → your calendar → "Secret address in iCal format". Outlook: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish → ICS link. We only read the start and end of busy appointments – never titles – and refresh every 15 minutes.
settings.feedLabel: 2. See the bookings in your calendar: subscribe to this address
settings.feedHelp: Google: "Other calendars" → + → "From URL". Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web. Keep the address secret – it shows customers' names and numbers.

activity.onlyAdmins: The activity log can only be viewed by owners and administrators.
activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: All changes in {name}, newest first. The log cannot be edited.

integrations.readersBlocked: Integrations can be viewed by staff, administrators and owners.
integrations.errorNotice: {name} was not connected ({error}). Try again, or contact Dialogbot.
integrations.title: Actions in your own systems
integrations.intro: When a system is connected, the assistant can take actions there during a call or in the web chat – e.g. book a time in your calendar or send an SMS confirmation. The customer always confirms first, and every action is shown in the conversation in the inbox. Only connected systems are used.
integrations.simulated: Test environment: connections and actions are simulated. Nothing is sent to real calendars, phones or webhooks.
integrations.viaZapierIntro: These systems have no direct connection yet. Connect Zapier or Make above, and events from Dialogbot (new lead, booking, completed action) can trigger your own automations there.
integrations.events: Events: new lead, booking created/cancelled, completed action, ended conversation.
integrations.secretNote: Shown only once – save it if you want to verify the signature (X-Dialogbot-Signature).
integrations.senderHint: At most 11 letters or digits. Empty = the business name.
integrations.conflict: The setup was changed by someone else. Reload the page.

telephony.readersBlocked: Telephony can be viewed by staff, administrators and owners.

mode.busy_or_no_answer: When we don't answer or the line is busy (recommended)

number.intro: Your number stays with your current carrier. You simply forward calls to a number Dialogbot assigns to you.
number.label: Business phone number
number.subscriptionType: What type of subscription is it?
number.when: When should the assistant answer the phone?
number.wantsNew: We would rather have a brand-new number or move our number to Dialogbot. We don't offer this right away. We will contact you, and you can use forwarding in the meantime.
number.confirmText: We call {number} and read out a 6-digit code. Enter the code below.
number.sent: The call is on its way. The code is valid for 10 minutes.

docs.title: Company details.
docs.intro: To assign you a Danish number, the telecom provider needs to know the business. Dialogbot passes the details on. You don't need to create any account. Status:
docs.uploaded: Documentation (uploaded – choose a new file to replace it)

guide.dialCode: Dial the code on the phone with your number and press call:

connect.intro: Once the number is confirmed, Dialogbot prepares a number for you to forward to. This happens at Dialogbot. You don't need to create accounts or enter technical details.

answering.hoursHint: Approve your opening hours in Knowledge
answering.special: Special greeting and speaking style for the phone
answering.style: Speaking style (e.g. 'We are informal with customers')

language.label: Language for your customers
language.help: Peter answers, recognises speech and greets in this language.
language.conflict: The language settings were changed by someone else. Reload the page.

test.notYet: Can be started once the phone is connected.
test.introBefore: When forwarding is on: start the test call, and within 15 minutes call from another phone to
test.introAfter: {number}. If you only forward unanswered calls, don't pick up. The assistant says "This is a test call", and the conversation lands in the inbox.
test.passed: The test call reached your assistant and was saved in the inbox.
test.own: I'm calling our own number so forwarding gets tested.

activate.active: The assistant is answering the phone. Calls land in the inbox.
activate.ready: Everything is ready. When you activate, the assistant answers the calls you forward.
activate.notReady: Can be activated after a passed test call and a confirmed subscription.

form.originsHint: One per line, with https:// and no path. The widget cannot be embedded elsewhere.

voices.readersBlocked: Voices can be viewed by staff, administrators and owners.
voices.title: Voice for your assistant
voices.intro: Choose the voice customers hear on the phone. The web chat doesn't use speech. Only voices that have passed Dialogbot's checks can be selected.
voices.engineSimulated: Test environment: the speech engine is simulated. Samples are a tone, not speech, and don't count as a tested voice.
voices.engineMissing: Choose the voice your customers will hear on the phone. More voices are added continuously.

steps.viaCall: Not needed for standard voices – you hear the voice and greeting in the test call.
steps.listenHint: Play the standard sample for the selected voice.
steps.greetingHint: Hear the greeting from Reception in this voice.
steps.testCallHint: Call your number. A saved choice is not a passed phone test.

standard.title: Choose phone voice
standard.intro: Natural voices that work right away. The choice applies to all your phone numbers and campaigns, and you can always switch. You hear the voice when you call your number.

library.title: Dialogbot voices
library.empty: More voices – including dialects and accents – are on the way. They will appear here once they have passed our checks of rights, audio quality and phone sound. Until then, the phone uses the voice you selected above.
library.textPlaceholder: E.g.: We have an available time on Wednesday 28 October at 10:30.

assignments.saved: Saved. New conversations use the voice; ongoing conversations keep their voice.
assignments.title: Assistants and campaigns
assignments.empty: No phone numbers or campaigns yet. They use the default voice when created.
assignments.campaignHint: Changing the voice never starts calls and doesn't change the price.
assignments.fallback: If the voice fails during a call
assignments.fallbackHint: The backup voice is the voice selected under Settings → Telephony.
assignments.fallbackProvider: Switch to the approved backup voice
assignments.fallbackTransfer: No backup voice – the call continues according to the telephony provider's error handling

pronunciations.title: Pronunciation dictionary
pronunciations.intro: Write how names should be pronounced, e.g. company names or place names. Applies to whole words. Version {version}. A change requires a new test call.

ownVoice.onlyAdmins: Your own voice can be created by administrators and owners.
ownVoice.title: Record your own voice
ownVoice.intro: Read a short script aloud directly in the browser. The voice is only used in your own workspace, and the speaker can always withdraw consent.

flag.for_kort: The recording is too short. Read the whole sentence.
flag.for_lang: The recording is too long. Stop recording once the sentence is read.
flag.for_lav: The audio is too quiet. Speak a little louder or hold the microphone closer.
flag.overstyret: The audio is clipping. Speak a little softer or hold the microphone further away.
flag.meget_baggrundsstøj: There is a lot of background noise. Find a quieter room.

manus.kort: Short script (approx. 2 minutes): quick voice right away
manus.standard: Standard script (approx. 30 minutes): best likeness once training is ready

consent.manuscriptHelp: The script uses your own details, so the speaker reads sentences about your business.
consent.typed: The speaker types their full name
consent.typedHint: Must be the person recording. Dialogbot reviews the consent before the voice can be used.
consent.accept: I am the speaker and give consent as described above.

studio.micError: The browser couldn't access the microphone. Allow the microphone in the address bar and try again.
studio.title: Recording: {name}
studio.submitIntro: When all sentences are approved, submit the recording. Dialogbot creates the voice and reviews the consent before it can be used.

status.withdrawn: Consent has been withdrawn. The recordings are deleted and the voice is not used.
status.ready: The voice is ready and can be selected on the voices page.
status.blocked: The consent was rejected. Contact Dialogbot.
status.pending: Awaiting Dialogbot's review of the consent and a sample of the voice.
status.withdrawWarning: The recordings are deleted and the voice stops immediately.

ownVoice.notice: Your own voice is made from a short recording. Likeness to the speaker may vary, especially for voices far from the model's training voices. Full likeness requires training on the standard script, which Dialogbot will offer later.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: For your own systems (CRM, Zapier, your own code) via Dialogbot's API. Give each key a name and only the permissions it needs.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.onceNote: It is shown only this once. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke «{name}»? Systems using it lose access immediately.
apiKeys.docs: How to use the key: send it as «Authorization: Bearer <key>» to Dialogbot's API (https://api.dialogbot.app/v1).
